name: AI Applyd
description: The serious candidate's edge, inside the assistant you already work in. 10 tools: ATS resume scoring, a resume rewritten for each specific role, cover letters, interview preparation, curated job matches, and applications completed and submitted on the employer's own hiring system across all fifteen major ATS platforms (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, iCIMS, Personio, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Rippling, Breezy, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, JazzHR, softgarden).

languages.select: Append ?lang=LOCALE to the transport URL, for example /mcp?lang=pt-BR. Supported: en, es, de, fr, pt-BR.

pricing.free_tier: Free AI Applyd account (Google sign-in, no card) with a 10,000-token starter grant. Every tool runs on your own AI credits.
